title: A calmer way to ship
source: Okay, a few thoughts for the next release. Let's keep the scope small. The dictation should feel at home on Omarchy. I want to see my words while I'm speaking, then turn the rough version into a clear note. Keep the original too. The little floating preview should stay readable as the thought gets longer. I don't want to chase a single disappearing line. Once the note is saved, I can come back to it, choose the version I like, and copy it into whatever I'm writing. Oh, and leave enough time to test it properly before we ship.
rewrite:
Keep the next release focused.

• Make dictation feel at home on Omarchy.
• Show live words while recording.
• Turn rough thoughts into clear notes.
• Preserve the original alongside every rewrite.
• Leave time for testing before release.
disclosure: Production GTK and Quickshell UI with a scripted transcript and local fake rewrite provider. No real audio, speech recognition, provider latency or live Hyprland session is represented.
